description: This file defines a controller class 'FreeCheckout' for handling the free checkout process in an OpenCart extension. It includes methods for displaying the checkout page and confirming the order, handling session data, order validation, and redirecting users upon success or failure.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: Controller class for handling free checkout process, extending the core Controller class in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the language file and renders the free checkout view page.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes the order confirmation, updating order status and redirecting users based on the order's validity and payment method.
